description: Hub-side structural checks on POST /v1/messages (SPEC §3, §6 rule 1). No keys are needed. expected is "ok" or the Hub error code: bad_request (400) or too_large (413). serialized_bytes, when present, is the UTF-8 byte length of the request envelope JSON to check against the 98304-byte limit. The envelope is strict: unknown fields are rejected; b64 fields must decode canonically to their exact lengths (salt 32, sig 64, collapse 16, ct 16..65552).

cases.name: ct uses the standard base64 alphabet
